system.description:
Favoured weapon: Trident

Granted power: Advantage on all checks involving water or storms. Once/day, when your Smite hits, a wave breaks over the target and a 15ft line behind it: each creature there makes a Fortitude save or is pushed 15ft and knocked prone.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Umberlee in the World of Arneyan wiki.
